title: SVG serializer parity to 0% diff
description: Reverse-engineer and match Figma SVG serialization exactly for parity scenarios. Target: canonical 0% diff first, then byte-identical SHA where feasible.

title: Build SVG canonical diff harness
description: Add deterministic canonicalization + comparator (ignore whitespace/attr order) and output structured mismatch diagnostics per path/style.
close_reason: Added svg_canonical_diff binary, parity script integration, and precision analyzer

title: Promote text.text-advanced to canonical 0%
description: Apply same serializer fixes to keep text.text-advanced at canonical 0% and prevent regressions.
notes: text.text-advanced remains canonical=false with same first-diff pattern in path numeric payload.

title: Scale parity pass across all scenarios
description: Run full scenario matrix; triage remaining non-text deltas and create follow-on beads by feature class.
notes: Ran cargo xtask parity_svg --all --precision 4. Current matrix has SVG pairs for 3 scenarios; 21 scenarios are skipped pending actual.svg generation.

title: Infer numeric formatting rules
description: Reverse-engineer Figma number formatting thresholds and rounding policy from expected.svg corpus. Encode as tested formatter.
notes: Current first-diff examples show 4th-decimal path deltas in glyph outlines (e.g., 29.7954 vs 29.7955). Decimal translation is now deterministic, so remaining drift appears upstream of serializer formatting.

title: Match path command compaction
description: Replicate Figma path command emission and compaction rules (M/L/H/V/C/Q/S/T/A/Z behavior and command repetition).
notes: Path translation now preserves command families and sequence while applying decimal coordinate offsets. Remaining canonical mismatch not explained by command compaction churn.
close_reason: Path translation now preserves original command families and sequence, with deterministic decimal coordinate translation

title: Stabilize path ordering for mixed text runs
description: Guarantee deterministic path ordering and run-to-fill mapping for text outlines, especially styled segments.
notes: Mixed-style-runs still has equal path count/order (12 paths each) but differing path payload lengths; likely shaping/output-content differences rather than element ordering.

title: Match style emission policy
description: Match fill/stroke/opacity/color keyword emission exactly (including black vs #000000 and omission of defaults).
close_reason: Style normalization now aligns black keyword emission for fill/stroke and omits opacity when value is 1

title: Match root and defs ordering
description: Match root/header, rect/background, defs/clip-path placement, and element ordering to Figma output conventions.

title: Remove non-essential path rewrites
description: Bypass or narrow normalization passes that mutate d strings unless strictly required for coordinate translation.
close_reason: Removed non-essential path rewrites; serializer now only translates with decimal math and preserves command layout

title: Golden tests for serializer parity
description: Add snapshot tests that assert canonical match for target scenarios and byte-hash lock for approved baselines.
close_reason: Added render_svg serializer unit tests and SHA-256 baseline guard via cargo xtask parity_svg_hash

title: Promote text.mixed-style-runs to canonical 0%
description: Use harness to drive text.mixed-style-runs from current delta to canonical-equivalent 0% SVG diff.
notes: After serializer hardening, text.mixed-style-runs canonical diff remains false; first mismatch occurs inside first path numeric payload.
